2.overview: Jiro awakens in hospital only to learn he is now under the surveillance of the Bureau of Espionage.

3.title: WHAT'S MY NAME?
3.overview: Jiro is cuffed in a van, and the tension could be cut with a katana thanks to Jiro’s escort, Ichika.

4.title: Two Is Not Enough
4.overview: Jiro is pitted against the newest recruit, Reiji, and each challenger’s fist has a tale to tell.

5.title: Young Gunz
5.overview: In a subterranean hold, an imposing monolith towers over Jiro and Reiji-- Rago’s former prison.

6.title: Turn Up
6.overview: Jiro, Ichika, and Reiji have been handed a new trial, this time from the “friendly” mononoke Fuyo.

7.title: 3 ON THREE
7.overview: Mononoke have just committed mass murder, but it's more than just all-you-can-eat human meat.

8.title: Underdog
8.overview: The dueler who confronted Reiji is his own kin and Shinji’s inner turmoil is about to finally erupt.

9.title: ONE
9.overview: Finally Jiro has gained consciousness, in a vast warehouse, behind the stone-cold stare of Kusumi.

10.title: Deadly Skillz
10.overview: Jiro enters a mononoke’s forest only to meet a new and odd mononoke in the form of a white snake.

11.title: Black or White
11.overview: Amagi’s dark ambitions have come to light, but Jiro is determined to save Rago and settle the score!

12.title: ONCE AGAIN
12.overview: A superpowered Amagi stands before Jiro while, cloaked in a Rago forcefield, a defiant Jiro awaits.

the-frontier-lord-begins-with-zero-subje.title: The Frontier Lord Begins with Zero Subjects

1.title: The Frontier Lord and the Girl with the Blue Horn
1.overview: Dias is awarded a domain for his wartime service, but there's one small problem. Does anyone even live there?

2.title: The Frontier Lord and His First Visitor
2.overview: Dias settles into daily life with Alna, and little by little, people begin to come calling.

3.title: The Frontier Lord and the Strange Merchant
3.overview: The population of Nezrose slowly grows, including a few surprises courtesy of an unusual visitor.

4.title: The Frontier Lord and the Neighboring Lord
4.overview: Dias meets the new lord of the neighboring domain, and he learns there are many rumors about them both.

5.title: The Frontier Lord and the Assailants from the Desert
5.overview: Dias tries his hand at farming, and Eldan sends a caravan of gifts to help him establish his domain.

6.title: The Frontier Lord and the Twins' Prayer
6.overview: Senai and Ayhan want to secretly help Dias cultivate his field. Can a new arrival offer them a solution?

7.title: The Frontier Lord and the New Subjects
7.overview: Expectations are low for a new group of dogkin immigrants, but Dias has some ideas for how they'd be useful.

8.title: The Frontier Lord and the Grassland Battle
8.overview: Diane's plans quickly go awry when she launches an attack on Dias in his own domain.

9.title: The Frontier Lord and the Wedding
9.overview: Klaus and Canis have grown close, and an event must be held, even if Dias is oblivious.

10.title: The Frontier Lord and His Son and Daughters
10.overview: A bunch of new faces arrive at Iluk Village, but not many of them turn out to be total strangers.

11.title: The Frontier Lord and Alna's Big Brother
11.overview: Zorg rushes home to save his sister Alna from the wicked domain lord, utterly unprepared for what awaits him.

12.title: The Frontier Lord and the Story That Began with Zero Subjects
12.overview: Eldan visits Dias' domain, and delivers a range of official tidings from the king.

1.title: I'm Yani Neko, Nya
1.overview: Catgirl Yani struggles to pay rent and spends what little she has on cigarettes — until an urgent text from her sister Imoko sparks a far greater crisis.

2.title: Meet My Juniors, Nya
2.overview: Yani wants to continue her carefree life, but she receives a job offer as financial pressure builds. Will she commit to this opportunity or her freedom?

3.title: I'm More Straight Than Funny, Nya
3.overview: After another clash with her landlord, Yani agrees to tend his garden to cover her rent. It seems like a perfect fix — until she faces his cabbage patch.

4.title: Freaks All Around Me, Nya
4.overview: Yani lands a job assisting Saori Tatsuro, a risque manga artist. After Yani mistakenly burns her manuscript, an unexpected police visit follows.

5.title: We're Off to a Secret Place, Nya
5.overview: Despite her sister's attempts to take away her cigarettes, Yani refuses to quit. At the same time, Imoko navigates a youthful romance.

6.title: Summer Starts and Ends Here, Nya
6.overview: Yani's fellow tenant Aruko disappears during a drinking party while three new assistants arrive at Tatsuro's workplace as her deadline looms closer.

7.title: I Was Born to Parents Too, Nya
7.overview: Yani takes a cleaning job at a shady underground facility. Meanwhile, her landlord welcomes a new houseguest, quickly followed by an unexpected mishap.

8.title: Even We Run Around in December, Nya
8.overview: Yani expects a lonely birthday, unaware that Imoko is planning a surprise party for her. Elsewhere, Yani's landlord becomes trapped in a foul time loop.

9.title: My Little Sis Is Popular, Nya
9.overview: Yani's peculiar toilet habits spark chaos around her while Imoko receives a gift from a secret admirer who turns out to be anything but ordinary.

10.title: I'm Gonnya Enjoy the Outing Too, Nya
10.overview: Yani's neighbors Yakuneko and Hameneko head to a mystical waterfall — but Hameneko's selfishness drives Yakuneko to hatch a wild revenge plan.

11.title: We're in Kyoto, Nya
11.overview: Yani and her flatmates set off on a Kyoto and Nara getaway — but her antics lead to an encounter with the "King of Deer," a creature of ancient wisdom.

12.title: I'm Gonnya Smoke Even in the Last Episode, Nya
12.overview: As her issues push the other residents to the edge, a worn-out Yani lashes out at her landlord — triggering the biggest brawl in the building's history.

the-exiled-heavy-knight-knows-how-to-gam.title: The Exiled Heavy Knight Knows How to Game the System

1.title: I'm Elymas the Heavy Knight
1.overview: Elymas Edvaughn is disowned by his father for becoming a Heavy Knight.

2.title: Menacing Foul Eight-Legged Beast
2.overview: Elymas uses his wits and game knowledge to defeat a much more powerful monster.

3.title: The Raid Quest
3.overview: Elymas finds himself surrounded by fearful newbies and an arrogant veteran on his first Raid Quest.

4.title: Existence Evolution
4.overview: With Gowtan paralyzed, Elymas must survive against the Mad Headder until he can get back in the fight.

5.title: Fang of Smoldering Insanity
5.overview: Elymas goes shopping for a skillbook only to discover they're prohibitively expensive.

6.title: Ruche the Pierrot
6.overview: Elymas begs Ruche to join his party so he can use her skills to find the item he needs.

7.title: Golden Raana Farming
7.overview: Elymas uses his game knowledge to exploit the weaknesses of the elusive Golden Raana.

8.title: Wandering
8.overview: Elymas and Ruche's celebration is interrupted by a wandering dungeon boss.

9.title: Dreamlord
9.overview: Ruche returns to save Elymas from a desperate situation, and they make one last gamble to beat the Dreamlord.

10.title: Negotiation
10.overview: Elymas and Ruche celebrate their payout and promotion and return to the shady shop for a Skill Book.

11.title: Inescapable Past
11.overview: Elymas' father hears about his success and visits the guild with Malice, who has a twisted attachment to him.

12.title: Malice the Master Swordsman
12.overview: Elymas activates the true power of the Heavy Knight to make a comeback against Malice.

13.title: Lacoryna, City of Adventurers
13.overview: After defeating Malice and saying goodbye to his father, Elymas visits Lacoryna, the holy land of adventurers.

14.title: Mythril Giant
14.overview: Elymas and Ruche take on an overpowering foe in hopes of acquiring powerful materials.

15.title: Dreamlord of the Dreamhole
15.overview: With their new skills gained on level up, Elymas and Ruche decide to take on the Rock Centipede.

16.title: No Defense Spared
16.overview: The Rock Centipede Existence Evolves into a Death Amude, trapping Elymas and Ruche in a desperate situation.

1.title: Lines and Walls
1.overview: After her classmates run off in fear, Koyuki makes faces in a mirror to figure out why everyone finds her scary. Suddenly, a boy sneaks up behind her.

2.title: Locksmith
2.overview: To Koyuki's relief, Yota comes to her rescue. After their initial study session, they grow more comfortable with each other — which unsettles Minato.

3.overview: Bothered that Koyuki still has her guard up around him, Minato tries to make small talk. As Miki grows suspicious of his intentions, she confronts him.

4.title: Impenetrable
4.overview: At Miki's prodding, Minato clarifies his interest in her best friend. An unexpected visitor triggers Koyuki's bad memories, leading to a harsh outburst.

5.title: Change
5.overview: Koyuki mulls over the tense exchange in the infirmary. After Yota clears the air, she tries to have an honest conversation with Minato for the first time.

6.title: New Semester
6.overview: As winter break ends, the usually calm Minato begins to realize his feelings are changing. Miki notices how close Yota and Koyuki have become.

7.title: Loneliness and Solitude
7.overview: After reflecting on her own loneliness and worrying that Yota is bottling everything up, Koyuki reaches out and asks about his true feelings.

8.title: On Equal Footing
8.overview: Determined not to mess up high school, Miki has faked her persona since day one. But not being herself around her classmates starts to wear her down.

9.title: Self-Awareness
9.overview: Minato realizes how Koyuki is always on his mind. Later, while hanging out at the new mall, the misunderstanding between the four friends deepens.

10.title: Spring
10.overview: A spring break trip to the amusement park brings the four friends closer. Back at school, Koyuki's surprised by a familiar face — and Minato takes notice.

11.title: Inversion
11.overview: Koyuki broods over her complicated past with Akine's sister, Manatsu, and what the first year might know. Meanwhile, Momoka sets her sights on Minato.

12.title: Thunder
12.overview: As Koyuki slowly notices her new, surprising feelings towards Minato, first-year Momoka suddenly tries to cozy up to her — for reasons she can't grasp.

13.title: Perception
13.overview: With Akine's words ringing in her head, Koyuki's feelings become complicated. Later, an accident causes something to shift between Miki and Yota.

14.title: Bombshell
14.overview: Unsure of how to move forward, Miki avoids Yota and confides in her colleagues. A bold Momoka confronts Koyuki about Minato and lights a fuse.

15.title: Clouds and Rain
15.overview: Gray skies mirror the group's uneasy mood. Momoka senses a chance to get closer to Minato, while Miki can barely face Yota after turning him down.

16.title: Stop and Go
16.overview: Cultural festival prep begins and Miki and Yota ease back to normal. But as Minato grapples with his desire to stay close to Koyuki, Momoka makes a move.

17.title: True Feelings
17.overview: Reeling from the news that Minato and Momoka are dating, Koyuki fights to keep her composure. Miki, meanwhile, confronts Minato about his true intentions.
